about:
Numotion maintains a service branch in Williston, Vermont, at 310 Hurricane Lane, Suite 3. The facility operates Monday through Friday with morning hours from 9:00 a.m. to 12:00 p.m. and afternoon hours from 1:00 p.m. to 5:00 p.m. For urgent needs outside regular hours, the company provides after-hours phone support on weekdays from 5:00 p.m. to midnight Eastern Time and on weekends from 10:00 a.m. to 7:00 p.m. Eastern Time. A fax line is also available at .

The branch delivers services by appointment only, with technicians available to visit customers' homes within the designated coverage area. In addition to on-site service, Numotion offers a digital tool called myNumotion that allows clients to live chat with support staff, view the status of their orders, and pay invoices online. The branch does not advertise any manufacturing or fabrication processes; its role is centered on equipment service, maintenance, and customer account management.

While the branch page does not list specific industries, the nature of the in-home service and order management suggests a focus on mobility and healthcare equipment customers. The branch handles service requests and order inquiries for individuals and organizations that rely on Numotion's products.

The company highlights the convenience of its mobile app and extended phone support as key differentiators, aiming to reduce the hassle of scheduling service and managing accounts. No founding date, ownership structure, or founder names are provided for this location.
